verdict.rationale: The pricing page lists "Multi-Cloud & Multi-Region" for Temporal Cloud, which suggests some choice of deployment location. The self-hosted guide (Docker, Kubernetes or manual) lets users run the Temporal Service on infrastructure they control, which implicitly decides where data lives. No documentation shows explicit region selection or data-residency guarantees, so the story is only partly evidenced. Missing for 10: first-party docs on choosing a Cloud region per namespace, explicit data-residency commitments (e.g. EU-only storage), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
